instruction: Set Trebuchet MS as the standard font for all Writer documents

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Trebuchet MS. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Trebuchet MS'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Trebuchet MS, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Correct state extraction: The vm_file getter fetches the correct LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) where default font settings are stored

Appropriate metric logic: The find_default_font function correctly parses the XML configuration file, searches for the XPath '/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont' with property 'Standard', and extracts the default font name
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction - that Trebuchet MS is set as the default/standard font
Correct expected value: 'Trebuchet MS' matches the instruction requirement exactly
Correct comparison logic: Binary comparison (font name == expected) is appropriate for this task
Runtime feasibility: The configuration file persists after task completion, no postconfig needed, and the XML structure is standard LibreOffice format
Data flow is sound: VM file getter → XML parsing → font name extraction → comparison with expected value
